# Fixtures

- `market-types.json`: fifteen items from ASX's market-wide announcement feed (5–9 October 2026), one per type label the alert matchers distinguish (trading halt, halt lifted, suspension, reinstatement, dividends incl. special and a warrant issuer's structured-products notice, results date, annual report, quarterly, profit guidance, results of meeting, progress report), trimmed to the fields the parser reads.
